nodes.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data.

A method and system for determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to specified parameters.

A type determined by the meaning of a term of the short message that provides information about the environment or context of the mobile device.<SEP>A classification of context data determined from a query, where the type is determined by the meaning of a term of a short message and provides information about an environment of a mobile device.<SEP>A type algorithmically determined by the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about an environment of the mobile device.

A source that provides the context-data type and is ranked according to a specified parameter.<SEP>A source that provides a particular context-data type and from which context data is requested and acquired.<SEP>A source that provides a context-data type; sources are algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost, and context data is requested from them.

A message received from a mobile device whose terms carry meaning used to determine a context-data type.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device by a server, from which a context-data type is determined and to which received context data may be appended or associated.<SEP>A message generated by a device to which relevant context-data is linked.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device whose terms have meanings used to determine a context-data type; relevant context data is linked to and formatted with the short message.

A device that generates a short message and a query, and to which received context data may be provided.<SEP>A device that sends short messages and receives context data through a communication network; context data may be appended to a short message generated by the mobile device.

A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data acquisition and ranking.<SEP>At least one server that collects a set of context data from at least one context-data provider.
A mobile device that receives context data, short messages, and forwarded messages with associated context data.

A parameter used to rank context-data sources, which may be a state of the receiving mobile device, a state of an available communication network, or a cost value of the context data.<SEP>A parameter used to rank context-data sources, which may include a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, or a state of an available communication network.<SEP>A parameter used to algorithmically rank context-data sources, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source.
A specified parameter representing the monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source.
A database available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.

A server that stores a database queried for context data associated with a received short message.<SEP>A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to access stored context data.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device.
A language used to encode received context data into a short message.
Instructions appended to query the database for the received context data in the short message.<SEP>Instructions appended to a short message to query a database for received context data.

An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter.<SEP>An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.<SEP>A network through which context data is communicated to a mobile device.
A mobile device that receives a short message and whose state may be a specified parameter.

Data provided by a context-data source, having a cost value and a context-data type.<SEP>Data of a context-data type obtained from a context-data source, possibly by a physical sensor, and rendered or appended for communication to a mobile device.
A type of mobile device that may generate the short message.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method.
An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute operations on short messages and context data.

A component of the computerized apparatus configured to execute program instructions to perform operations.<SEP>At least one processor configured to execute program instructions to perform operations including receiving short messages, determining context-data types, identifying and ranking context-data sources, and generating context-data requests.
A component of the computerized apparatus having program instructions.
Instructions executed by at least one processor to perform operations related to short messages and context data.
A provider that is allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.<SEP>A provider from which a set of context data related to a meaning of short message content is collected by at least one server.
A measure according to which relevant context data is algorithmically selected, comprising a monetary cost of the context data.
A sensor that obtains context-data.<SEP>A sensor by which context data is obtained.

A protocol according to which the relevant context-data and the short message are formatted.<SEP>A protocol according to which relevant context data and the short message are formatted, such as a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.
A type of communication protocol comprising a cellular network short message protocol.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising a cellular network short message protocol.
A type of communication protocol comprising an internet communication protocol.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising an internet communication protocol.
A list of context-data elements weighted according to at least one metric, from which context data is selected.
An apparatus comprising at least one processor configured to execute program instructions to perform operations involving short messages and context data.

A method comprising collecting context data from context-data providers, selecting relevant context data according to a metric, linking it to a short message, and formatting them according to a communication protocol.
Data obtained by a physical sensor that is linked to a short message and formatted according to a communication protocol.
A device that generated the short message and has a physical context to which the context data is related.

edges.description: The patent document US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The context-data acquisition and ranking method algorithmically determines a context-data type from a query.
The method identifies at least one context-data source that provides the context-data type and generates a request for context data from that source.
The method algorithmically ranks context-data sources according to a specified parameter.
The method receives a short message from a mobile device with a server and determines a context-data type from a term of the short message.
The method provides received context data to the device that generated the short message.
The method provides received context data to a recipient mobile device.
The method stores received context data in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The method forwards a Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server to the receiving mobile device.
The method encodes received context data into the short message with a markup language.
The method appends metadata instructions to query the database for received context data in the short message.
The context-data type is determined by the meaning of a term of the short message.<SEP>The context-data type is algorithmically determined by the meaning of a term of the short message.
